items.title: Should You Trim Or Add To Your BlackBerry Position Now?
items.summary: BlackBerry (BB) sales over the past twelve months were roughly flat compared to a year earlier, yet its share price refused to sit still. So, does the valuation justify initiating a position, or should existing holders consider trimming gains? Part of the answer is clear: the stock price has outpaced sales growth. From here, future performance will largely hinge on execution across its software divisions business.

items.title: How Does Motorola Solutions (MSI) Fit Into Louisiana's Statewide Public Safety Overhaul?
items.summary: Motorola Solutions (NYSE:MSI) secured a long term statewide public safety technology contract with Louisiana covering multiple agencies. The agreement expands Louisiana's existing land mobile radio network partnership to include body cameras, evidence management tools and smart radios. New features in the rollout include real time situational awareness platforms and language translation capabilities for frontline personnel. items.title: Why Did Axon Stock Fall Ten Percent On A Convertible That Pays No Interest?
items.summary: Axon Enterprise (AXON) fell 9.8% on Tuesday after announcing plans to sell $1.0 billion of convertible senior notes carrying a 0% coupon. Money at no interest sounds cheap. The market read it as a sign that Axon's growth is not yet paying for itself.

items.title: Motorola Solutions Inc's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: Motorola Solutions Inc (NYSE:MSI) recently announced a total dividend of $1.21 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-16.  This includes a cash dividend of $1.21 per share payable on 2026-10-15.  For income-focused investors, the ex-dividend date is a critical marker: shareholders must own the stock before this date to qualify for the payment.
